plain: In 2025, the podcaster Joe Rogan says, he had a vivid dream in which very slender, tall, humanlike beings talked to him, not gray but pinkish, like us. Rogan tells Michels about it himself, comes back to it later as the crazy dream of being in contact with those beings, and adds that he came away feeling someone was trying to get him used to this.
